scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Business blog, Gen Z taste report, Design the Exit guidance, Performance+ creative-learning guidance and current public design-inspiration result pages were checked on 20 October 2026. The durable new creative signal is user-led, visual-first taste discovery: niche identity territories, explicit personal agency, safe experimentation and human curation alongside AI. Design-to-action and performance learning remain relevant but are already covered. Four public Pinterest ideas pages exposed search metadata but returned HTTP 403 when opened, so no visual conclusions were drawn from inaccessible content.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.24.0 with 719 commands was read before evaluation. /moodboard curates one chosen direction and /trend-to-brand adapts a known trend, but neither turns mixed references, moods, values and dislikes into comparable taste territories with explicit human choice points. /taste-discovery-system was added as one reusable, cross-category command. All 719 prior commands, 42 categories, 40 executable bundle mappings, settings, personal creative intelligence and Firefox updater controls were preserved; 22 regression checks passed.
trends: Niche visual identities are being built from moods and values rather than broad mass-market aesthetics
Visual comparison helps people explore a vibe, narrow options and make more confident creative or purchase decisions
AI is most useful when it sharpens options while leaving interpretation, curation and final taste decisions with the person
Taste exploration benefits from safe, non-performative space to try, reject and remix directions without being pushed toward popularity
Current public inspiration snippets repeat bold or maximal typography, glass, pixel, modular-grid, 3D and disruptive-design motifs already covered by the catalogue
Launch-test-scale learning loops and strong creative inputs remain important but are already handled by /performance-creative-mix, /catalog-creative-system and /intent-to-action
commands_added: /taste-discovery-system — converts references, moods, values and dislikes into three distinct visual taste territories, like-for-like comparisons, a human preference map and coordinated cross-category applications
skipped: No Gen-Z-taste, micro-identity or niche-aesthetic aliases because one durable taste-discovery workflow covers the reusable behavior without demographic stereotyping or trend churn
No separate AI-taste or Pinterest-Assistant command because human agency and visual comparison belong inside the discovery workflow rather than a tool-specific command
No Performance+ campaign-operations command because /performance-creative-mix, /catalog-creative-system and /intent-to-action already cover strong inputs, controlled tests, learning and action paths

No bold-type, glass-branding, pixel-grid, 3D-type or disruptive-design aliases because existing typography, layout, brand, distortion and trend-to-brand controls already cover those production behaviors
No visual command was derived from public Pinterest pages that returned HTTP 403
